releases.displayName: Faraway Tales + Free Challenge Update are live!

notes.title: Knightica 1.4.0: Faraway Tales + a free Challenges update

items.text: Our first DLC, Faraway Tales, is out! And as a surprise, every player also gets a free update with a brand new Challenges mode.
3 new Commanders
Crystalist: fill your Field with Rocks that break when they level up and drop rewards.
Corsair: complete Bounties for rewards that keep growing, while the Raider ranks up with each one.
Emperor: unlock Traits, bonuses for fielding troops of the same type.
New troops for every Commander: Elder Dragon, Moon Bud & Sun Bud, Guardian and Hunter.
3 new events: Barracks, Whispering Fountain and Witch Crypt.
9 new trinkets and new treasures: Topaz, Amethyst, Rare Candy and Relics.
Get Faraway Tales on Steam

notes.title: New Challenges mode, unlocked after 2 victories

items.text: 3 hand-made challenges every week, the same for everyone. New ones every Wednesday at 9:00 UTC.
Each challenge picks your Commander, adds special rules and changes the Shop.
Your first victory in each challenge gives bonus XP, and wins count for unlocks and achievements.
Faraway Tales owners get a 4th weekly challenge with one of the new Commanders.
Retry your run from the defeat screen or the pause menu.
Drag & drop swaps and bench merges. Benched troops now get merge, XP and level-up effects too.
Audio overhaul: new music, ambiences and attack sounds.
A livelier Shop and HUD, balance changes and lots of fixes.
Thanks for playing! Come share your best challenge runs with us on Discord.
Get Faraway Tales

releases.displayName: The Trinket Trials Update is here!

items.text: Hello everyone!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3093400/Knightica/"]
Step into the Trinket Trials, where your progress and mastery forge your arsenal.
The entire Trinket system has been rebuilt from the ground up. Previously, players could pick 1 out of 3 randomly offered trinkets from a pool of about 15.
Now, you’ll be choosing between 80 unique trinkets, all tied to your personal progression.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107687/995cee71ad6b21237fbf82d2544db55a64daa7e6.png"]
80 total trinkets, from starting with a specific Blob to launching Battle Start effects twice!
Lots of new effects, allowing wild builds! Be creative!
No more random offers! Your build, your choice.

notes.title: There are three distinct Trinket types

items.text: Power: Enhance gameplay with direct bonuses.
Challenge: Increase difficulty in exchange for higher XP multipliers.
Class: Special trinkets tied to each class.
Trinkets are unlocked through XP earned during runs, increased by:
Battles won
Difficulty selected
Challenge Trinkets
Class Trinkets require you to win Campaign runs with each class!
Reach level 50 and play with all classes to unlock them all!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107687/db1cd123406cdf5c26d2182fe05d11fff6436cc9.png"]
Reached the maximum level already? It’s only the beginning! Choose multiple Trinkets and find the best combo or face the hardest challenges!
10 new achievements introduced to celebrate your milestones in the Trinket Trials.
Already a veteran in the game? Start at an already advanced level to test Trinkets and get closer to the maximum level faster!
But wait - there's more!
Face new foes, unlock new powers — a full set of 9 fresh Boss Souls has been added to enrich late-game builds and mastery paths.
A deadly new ranged Troop joins the roster!
The Poison Blob siphons 🛡️ from adjacent allies and itself, converting the stolen defense into pure ⚔️ power.
A high-risk, high-reward damage dealer for creative, aggressive builds.
Endless Mode now features its own dedicated music loop to set the tone for long runs.
Improved the clarity of new Unlocked elements, specifying if it’s a Class, a Difficulty, a Mode, a Trinket or a Feature.
Added a tooltip to explain difficulties, showing the Tile cost, the maximum damage you can take in a normal battle, and the bonus XP you’ll receive
Badge
Cost reduced from 4 to 2: Pacifist
Lose 10% ⚔️but gains 120% of it back as🛡️(up from -4 but gains 100%): Glass Canon
Lose 10% 🛡️but gains 120% of it back as⚔️(up from -4 but gains 100%): Gambler
If you’ve rolled 3 times this turn, get +3%/+3% (up from +2/+3): Lone Wolf
If Troop as no adjacent allies, +5%/+5% (up from +4/+4): Copy
Spawns a Phantom of the Troop with 25%🛡️and ⚔️ (up from 10%): Valiant
+2⚔️ or +3🛡️ for each adjacent Knighthood ally (up from +1⚔️ or +2 🛡️): Chivalry
On Merge: If Ally is a Knighthood, gains +2⚔️or +3🛡️(up from +1⚔️ or +1 🛡️): Sniper
Now gives +1% ⚔️ instead of +2⚔️
Selfish and other negative effects should properly work with Infinity. Negative infinity buffs are now replaced with infinity buffs
Restricted Spells trinket doesn't stop Treasures from being properly used anymore
Experience filling sound is now properly stopped if continuing during the animation
Have fun! 🎉

Many of you have been asking for an update including a Codex/Bestiary, so we’ve been working on it. Here’s what it looks like:

Hello everyone!

Just a quick message for a quick patch. In rare cases, when crashing/quitting the game while the save was being written made some of you lose al of your progress. While it did not happen to a lot of people, we actively investigated because that's a huge issue if that ever happens.
Good news is, this patch fixes the issue and this should not happen ever again
Bad news is, that if that happened and you cannot find your save back in the cloud, your save is lost.

However, if this happened to you, please reach out on Discord or at support@goblinzstudio.com and we'll do our best to reconstruct a save for you if you're able to remember which character you had unlocked, and also if you've cleared any dificulty with any given commander
We're very sorry this happened in the first place.
We're currently still working on the bestiary and will give you more news on that when we have anything to share!
Have a wonderful day, and as usual, thanks for playing Knightica!

Hello everyone!

Here we are for our second post-launch patch, focusing on the Endless mode! While the patchnote itself might be shorter, you should see the difference with the endless! Remember however, that even if the curve should be smoother, endless is still supposed to be a challenge!

We've also added some QoL requests you've made, like shop rarity odds, and made a second fix for the Gladiator Achievement, so you don't have to beat Arena mode 10 times again to unlock it. If you did beat the mode 10 times, the Achievement should trigger when winning or losing one more Arena game. We still need you to reach the end screen of the mode one way or another to update the stat
If you didn't beat the mode 10 times yet, your progress should be tracked normally.
Please keep us posted!
We're now focusing on something widely requested, but that requires more time : the Bestiary!
We'll keep you posted and might still make some patches until then, just don't be surprised if there are less during the next couple of weeks ; we'll be focused on it!

Keep on posting feedback on the forums, we'll still be there! While we sometimes try to back off a bit as it's also a place for players to exchange bewteen them, we feel it is important for us to keep a connection with you and give insights when it is relevant.
We've also seen a lot of people either posting positive reviews, or switching their reviews from negative to positive. From the whole team, thank you! It is really heartwarming to see.
Next step, get out of Mixed reviews by going back to 70+%! :D

We really hope this new version of the Endless mode will be more enjoyable, and we'll fine-tune it to your feedback on the forums or on Discord (it's great to have them there because it's easier for us to ask you questions!)
We see that there is still a lot of you playing Knightica, thank your for this, and we hope you're all having fun!

Hello everyone!

Here we are, the first patch for Knightica! As stated in yesterday's news, it will be focused on improving the overall feeling and balance of Normal mode. Since we then expect people to win more often, we're also tuning down Endless 1-3 and endless 13.

Those changes are not definitive as they won't completely fix what we want to fix about the Endless mode, but we feel it's a great start so people can get a taste of it without feeling kicked out of their game right in endless 1.

However, we expect the complete Endless overhaul to provide better results, and this is coming for the next patch that will be released either on Friday or on Monday. We'll do our absolute best to release it on Friday, but we also don't want to rush it if we're not 100% sure the patch is ready.

Arena mode should also feel better to play, do not hesitate to try it and give us feedback! There are also other things like bugfixing (Memory leak issue and the Gladiator achievement, among other things, should be fixed!)
But before the detailed patchnote, we wanted to say a few more words.

Firstly, we’d like to apologize to those of you still experiencing issues that may have led you to put the game aside for now, and even after this first patch. Please know that we're taking every feedback into account, but we had to prioritize certain ones first. We’re doing our very best, and we truly hope you’ll give the game another shot once everything is resolved.
Secondly, if you did not review the game yet and feel like doing it now, or if you gave it a negative review and feel like switching it to positive, do not hesitate! :D
But if you feel like it's too soon to switch it yet, we're still working hard on next patches so you'll be convinced eventually!

Lastly and most importantly, we've received a lot of kind words about the game, about how we've been communicating with you, and it is truly heartwarming. We hope you'll love this first patch and that you'll be looking forward for the next. Thank you so much for your patience, and for playing Knightica ; we'll keep on doing our best
Now, on to the detailed patchnote (where we tell you our intent, but also, because we've learned the lesson, we're sharing numbers! :D) :
Balancing
We’ve adjusted overall balance so Normal Mode feels fairer and more approachable. A few under-tuned elements made some runs feel unwinnable.
We still want to keep the challenge of other Difficulties so players that want to push the game still feel rewarded! The overall feeling of Hard and Insane will feel the same as Patch 1.0.0a
All Campaign Modes
Reduce Elite Monster scaling by 20%
We are reducing Elite Monster battles scaling so they are weaker on World 2 and 3. They were meant to be difficult but could feel extremely hard, especially on higher difficulties.
Normal Mode
General
Reduce Boulder enemies Damage by 20%
Reduce Normal Battles Attack/Defense by 10%
Increase Invokers damage to themself from 10% to 20%
Reduce Max Damage Commander could receive from 50 to 35
This will stay at 50 on Hard Mode and without limit on Insane Mode

We received a lot of feedback that Bosses were too overwhelming. Bosses should be challenging but never feel impossible to beat especially in Normal Mode. We are reducing their Attack and Defense so they keep this “challenging” feeling but reducing the frustration
Bosses
Reduce Spider Queen Attack and Defense by 10%
Reduce Tentacle Lord Attack by 20%
Reduce Tentacle Lord Defense by 10%
Reduce Dark Sorcerer Attack and Defense by 10%
We’ve strengthened several early units to make comps feel better out of the gate. Burrower is no more RNG-gated, and Dragons should feel much stronger as Eggs scale up.
Troops
Sorcerer base Attack value : 6 => 7
Mage base Attack value : 10 => 12
Burrower Loot chances : 45% => 100%
Salamander base Defense : 2 => 5
Salamander Effect increase : 200% => 250%
Battle Start: +1 to all allies in the Front row. +2 if they are Nature
Dragons base Stats have been increased by 30%
We are currently working on improving the Endless Mode for the next patch. In the meantime we are reducing the scaling of some thresholds so it feels less punitive.
Endless Mode
Reduce Endless 1-3 scaling by 20%
Reduce Endless scaling starting from Endless 13
We are really sorry about the misinterpretation of the Arena Mode. This mode contains handcrafted compositions made by the development team and is not PvP.
As it is faster, we are reducing the amount of Gold needed to unlock new tiles, allowing more compositions.
We are still looking for your feedback on this Mode and we’ll be monitoring how it feels in the next few days.
Arena
From 15 to 17 Gold
From 1 to 2 Free Rerolls
Tiles unlock cost 3 Gold instead of 6
Improved the description to ensure it is not mistaken for a full PvP mode

Sorry to every completionist about that, you will now be able to unlock all the achievements :)

Hello everyone!
Less than 24 hours after the launch of Knightica, we are just overwhelmed by how many of you bought the game, as well as by your kind words and support. You truly made our day!
We’ve also taken into account your more critical feedback, especially regarding game balance, and we’ll make sure to update the game accordingly to make it as enjoyable as possible.

We ran several playtests to ensure the game would be as polished and balanced as possible, but now that many more players are enjoying the full version, we’re receiving even more feedback. We want to reassure you that, right after Gamescom, we’ll be working on it, so stay tuned for updates very soon!
In the meantime, many of you asked us to share the patch notes for version 1.0, so here they are:
The roster has grown a lot. There are now 49 troops in the game, each with their own effects, roles, and potential synergies.
Among the new Troops, the Blob changes effect and color every run, to give you a more varied experience!
A totally new type is now available, Ancient. The Ancient Troops are made of untamed magic and armor. They heavily rely on Spells and Enchantments!
The Lancer and the Sergeant got reinforcements! New Knighthood Troops help you make the most strict army with effects relying on the type!
With more variety than ever, your approach to team-building, scaling, and reacting to the shop will evolve every time you play. No two runs will feel the same.
Each Commander offers a different way to see the game: some mess with your economy, others shift your priorities or add new mechanics entirely.
From the Warlock spending his own life to unleash powerful curses to the Enchanter creating a magic tile on the floor to boost allies, you’ll have plenty of ways to save the Kingdoms!
We can’t wait to see which ones you’ll call your main.
After finishing your campaign, you can now go… further.
Endless Mode pushes your team into tireless waves of demons growing in power very fast.
How long can you last?
Arena Mode is all about fairness, tension, and decisions.

You fight random armies that were created with the same amount of Gold and the same amount of rerolls you have. With this fast-paced mode, you have to adapt to your Shop and create innovative armies to survive.
Win 10 matches to prove your worth as a gladiator!
Think you’ve mastered the game?
Hard Mode – tougher scaling, tighter margins, stronger bosses
Insane Mode – brutal pacing, zero forgiveness, high-stress decisions every turn
These are designed for veterans who want to challenge their army-building skills and are ready to try multiple times!
We’ve added a full Achievement system to track your craziest moments and give you some extra goals to chase.
Whether you're in it for 100% completion, trying oddball builds, or just want to prove something to everyone else: there's something here for you.

As mentioned at the start of this post, we monitor all of your feedback to make the game as balanced as possible. If you have any thoughts, feel free to share them through this Steam post or on our Discord server—we’re open to any kind of feedback you may have. Our top priority now is to address the main issues regarding balancing, but please let us know if there’s anything else you’d like to share.
Also, if you’re enjoying the game, please consider leaving a positive review. Reaching above 80% positive ratings helps tremendously with Steam’s algorithm and the game’s future.
We’ll keep you updated very soon. In the meantime, have fun, and thank you once again from the bottom of our hearts for your support! ❤️
Hello everyone!
First of all, we wanted to thank you for the support you've shown for the demo of Knightica! We're very happy to see that you are interested in the future of the game!
We also thank you for all you feedback, either here or on Discord, which helps us improving the game further!
Speaking of which, thanks to this feedback, bug reports, and analytics, and since the Next Fest is starting tonight, we've made a first patch with different changes!
Please find everything that's changed below, and thanks again for playing Knightica!
Changed the victory flow of the demo (after the “Thank you for playing,” sum up of your army!).
Improved Succubus tooltip for better clarity.
Added an option to disable Screen Shake for players who prefer a more stable visual experience.
Improved game localization across various languages.
Succubus was overperforming, so we’re reducing its impact in battle:
Reduced the explosion radius of Succubus projectiles (2 ⇒ 1.75).
Reduced damage of Succubus projectiles (35% ⚔️ ⇒ 24% ⚔️).
Necromancer’s ability to spam Zombies was too strong in prolonged fights:
Increased Zombie spawn cooldown (7s ⇒ 10s).
Salamander had an overwhelming synergy with Spirits, making it too easy to stack buffs:
Reduced Salamander buff copy percentage (200%/400%/600%... ⇒ 200%/300%/400%)
Burrowers now have a higher chance to provide Defensive Nut or Power Nut, increasing their strategic value.
Dealer’s ⚔️ gain on a lucky roll was a bit too high:
Reduced ⚔️ gain when rolling a 6 (3 ⚔️ ⇒ 2 ⚔️).
Meteor Artifact was slightly overtuned in terms of damage output:
Reduced Meteor Artifact attack damage (15% ⚔️ ⇒ 10% ⚔️).
Spider Queen was underwhelming compared to other major threats:
Increased Spider Queen attack damage (60 ⚔️ ⇒ 70 ⚔️).
Increased Spider Queen Defense (350 ⇒ 385).
Tentacle Lord was too easy to defeat, so we’re making it more durable and aggressive:
Increased Tentacle Lord Health (1000 ⇒ 1200).
Reduced attack cooldown (6s ⇒ 3.75s) but adjusted its damage accordingly.
Increased tentacle Defense (100 ⇒ 200).
Demon armies in the second half of World 2 now have increased power to maintain difficulty scaling.
Hustle now increases Reroll cost by 8 (was 3) to prevent excessive reroll abuse.
Elitist now reduces the cost of Epic troops added by 2 (was 4) for better balance.
Agony now gives +3 Gold per turn (was 4) to bring it in line with other economy options.
Enhancement now gives +3 Gold per Enchant/Artifact equipped (was 2) to make it more rewarding.
Sacrifice now grants 125% of the ⚔️ and 🛡️ of the sacrificed troop, making it a more valuable high-risk, high-reward choice.
Wisdom has been simplified:
Now gives +4 Gold when any troop reaches Level 5.
Now gives +8 Gold when any troop reaches Level 10.
Fixed an issue with the Commander bag not displaying correctly.
Fixed an issue where the game could softlock when using Flawless on Boss Battles.
Fixed an issue that caused Sentinel effects to proc despite the level not really being gained.
Fixed an issue where the Chaos Lord could push enemies away when flying toward them.
Fixed an issue where you could die with Agony.
Fixed an issue where you could launch the Demo in an early Hard mode.
Fixed an issue when displaying Troops or Treasures in Trinket selection.
Fixed an issue where taking Recruit or Experienced Help as Start Effects was not giving any troops.
Fixed an issue where you could still buy and hover over items in Events.
Fixed an issue where HUDs weren’t updating correctly when the Princess was placed on the field.
Fixed an issue where the Princess could give her Max Level buff while on the bench.
Fixed an issue where the Necromancer was incorrectly interacting with Spirit.
Fixed an issue where some HUD elements would stay on-screen forever.
Fixed a bug where hovering the Spider Queen tile while merging could create a conflict between HUDs.
Fixed a bug where you could collect multiple Souls, causing sounds to trigger multiple times.
Fixed a bug where Troops could be duplicated on the Bench.
Fixed a bug where Troops could sometimes disappear from the Bench.
Polish localization: Troop names are now in Polish, not Spanish (>_<).
